mapper.select: SELECT id, url, thumb, taken_at, note, audio_url, audio_duration, featured, deleted, created_at FROM photo WHERE deleted = #{deleted} ORDER BY taken_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, url, thumb, taken_at, note, audio_url, audio_duration, featured, deleted, created_at FROM photo WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (url, thumb, taken_at, note, audio_url, audio_duration, featured, deleted) VALUES (#{url}, #{thumb}, #{takenAt}, #{note}, #{audioUrl}, #{audioDuration}, #{featured}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE photo SET deleted = #{deleted} WHERE id = #{id}
